```{r}
#Loading packages
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(naniar)
library(DHARMa)
library(gtsummary)
library(broom)
library(moments)
library(car)
#install.packages("lme4", type = "source")
library(lme4)

```

```{r}
#Reading in data
cleaned_seaotter_data <- read_csv(here("Data/cleaned_seaotter_data.csv"))
```

```{r}
#Filtering only usable data
cleaned_seaotter_data <- cleaned_seaotter_data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(month)) %>% 
  filter(sex_cd == "f" | sex_cd == "m") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(site_name)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(dive_time)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(dive_num)) %>% 
  filter(visibility_cd != "un") %>% 
  filter(ageclass_cd != "u") %>% 
  filter(success_cd == "y" | success_cd == "n") %>% 
  mutate(month = as.factor(month)) %>% 
  mutate(dive_num = as.factor(dive_num)) %>% 
  mutate(ageclass_cd = factor(ageclass_cd, levels = c("p", "j", "s", "a", "o"))) %>% 
  mutate(visibility_cd = factor(visibility_cd, levels = c("po", "fa", "go", "vg", "ex"))) %>% 
  mutate(success_cd = case_when(success_cd == "y" ~ 1,
                                success_cd == "n" ~ 0))
```


```{r}
#Nested Logistic regression 
success_model1 <- glmer(success_cd ~ month + sex_cd + dive_time + dive_num + ageclass_cd + visibility_cd + (1 | site_name), 
                        data = cleaned_seaotter_data, family = "binomial")

success_model_nodivenum <- glmer(success_cd ~ month + sex_cd + dive_time + ageclass_cd + visibility_cd + (1 | site_name), 
                        data = cleaned_seaotter_data, family = "binomial")

summary(success_model1)
summary(success_model_nodivenum)

summary(success_model_nodivenum)
simulateResiduals(success_model1) %>% 
  plot()
simulateResiduals(success_model_nodivenum) %>% 
  plot()

AIC(success_model1, success_model_nodivenum)

```
